experimentPlan.purpose: Separate fixed parent/action jobs from optional guaranteed primary replay jobs after observed baseline drift. Retain the simpler implementation if added replay stages do not establish a benefit.
experimentPlan.processes: fresh process per entry; one unmeasured 10000-node warmup, then measured short and normal full request
experimentPlan.sampling: 50ms schedstat plus search lifecycle log markers; no other own game tests/builds during sequence

scope: Headless fixed work and final correctness; user deferred visible Steam; no release or backend replacement

units.bytes: integer bytes; displayed GB is decimal 1e9
units.jobElapsed: Stopwatch elapsed, includes waits/preemption/GC; overlapping and not CPU time
units.searchMeanCores: 50ms schedstat proxy: expansion lanes plus all .NET TP Worker; marker/window and exited-thread gaps apply

limitations: Two formal samples per variant; original full search drift 7.17%. Not a statistical significance test or stable speed multiplier.
Short mean reduction 2.19% is smaller than observed drift; no established short-search speedup.
RSS sampled every 100ms and includes game/runtime/Mods; no hard memory bound.
Candidate still has only death routes with projected loss 9; no new winning route.
No final visible Steam, Windows game, full native deployment or incremental performance run.
